posts.title: Leaving Squirro after 18 years
posts.description: After 18 years, I will leave Squirro at the end of October. I will obviously stay connected to the company as a shareholder and strong supporter. posts.title: Kids Backyard Ultra in Zollikon
posts.description: On September 27, 2026 we are organising the first dedicated Backyard Ultra for Kids in Zollikon, Switzerland. The goal is to run for as long as possible (with a sensible upper ceiling in place). If you have a kid aged 3 to 15, come and join us at this event.
